summary: Google DeepMind's Josh Woodward announced a new wave of Gemini integrations with a list of third-party apps including OpenTable, Otter, GetYourGuide and others.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims Gemini can act across everyday apps, implying tool-calling into third-party services, but gives no detail on scale or mechanism.
mechanisms.quote: Gemini gets things done across the apps you use every day.

categories.reason: Several named partners (OpenTable, GetYourGuide, Thumbtack, Fever) are consumer marketplace/booking apps being integrated with Gemini as a new distribution surface.

practices.reason: New app integrations rolling out could require third-party developers to integrate with Gemini, but no specifics on protocol or interface change are given.
practices.quote: Starting today, another wave of integrations are rolling out.
